source.en: AMLO (Cap. 615) Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1; AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.9
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》（第615章）附表1第1部第1條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.9段

en.q: Under the AMLO, “money laundering” is defined as an act intended to have what effect?
options: Making property that is the proceeds of an indictable offence not appear to be, or represent, such proceeds
Concealing a customer's identity when carrying out a remittance transaction
Transferring funds out of Hong Kong without holding an MSO licence
Splitting a large transaction into several smaller transactions to avoid reporting
en.explain: Schedule 1, Part 1, s.1 of the AMLO defines ML as an act intended to make property that is (or represents) the proceeds of an indictable offence not appear to be such proceeds. The other options describe conduct that may be unlawful but is not the statutory definition of money laundering.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，「洗錢」一詞指出於達致何種效果的意圖的行為？
options: 使屬可公訴罪行的收益（或代表該等收益）的財產，看似並非該等收益
在進行匯款交易時隱瞞客戶身分
未持有金錢服務經營者牌照而將資金匯出香港
將大額交易拆細為多宗小額交易以規避申報
tc.explain: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條將「洗錢」界定為：意圖使屬可公訴罪行收益（或代表該等收益）的財產看似並非該等收益的行為。其他選項或屬違法行為，但並非「洗錢」的法定定義。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.10段

en.q: Which of the following correctly lists the three common stages of money laundering, in order?
options: Placement → layering → integration
Integration → placement → layering
Placement → structuring → conversion
Collection → transfer → withdrawal
en.explain: The Guideline (¶1.10) identifies three common stages: placement (disposal of cash proceeds into the financial system), layering (complex transactions to disguise the source) and integration (creating apparent legitimacy for the funds).

tc.q: 下列哪項正確依次列出洗錢的3個常見階段？
options: 存放 → 分層交易 → 整合
整合 → 存放 → 分層交易
存放 → 拆細 → 兌換
籌集 → 轉移 → 提取
tc.explain: 指引第1.10段指出洗錢有3個常見階段：存放（把非法活動的現金得益注入金融體系）、分層交易（以複雜多層交易隱藏款項來源）及整合（為犯罪得來的財富製造表面合法性）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.10(b)段

en.q: In the money laundering process, “layering” refers to which of the following?
options: Separating illicit proceeds from their source through complex layers of financial transactions to disguise the source and subvert the audit trail
Disposing of cash proceeds derived from illegal activities into the financial system
Creating the impression of apparent legitimacy for criminally derived wealth
Keeping criminal proceeds in cash so that they never enter the financial system
en.explain: Layering separates illicit proceeds from their source by creating complex layers of financial transactions designed to disguise the source, subvert the audit trail and provide anonymity (¶1.10(b)). Disposing cash into the financial system is placement; creating apparent legitimacy is integration.

tc.q: 在洗錢過程中，「分層交易」是指下列哪項？
options: 透過複雜多層的金融交易，將非法得益與其來源分開，從而隱藏款項來源及掩飾審計線索
處置來自非法活動的現金得益並注入金融體系
為犯罪得來的財富製造表面的合法性
將犯罪得益保存為現金，使其永不進入金融體系
tc.explain: 分層交易指透過複雜多層的金融交易，將非法得益及其來源分開，從而隱藏款項來源、掩飾審計線索和隱藏擁有人身分（第1.10(b)段）。把現金注入金融體系是「存放」；製造表面合法性是「整合」。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.10(a)段

en.q: A drug trafficker brings a large amount of street cash to a money changer and converts it into another currency, moving it into the financial system for the first time. This best illustrates which stage of money laundering?
options: Placement
Layering
Integration
Refinancing
en.explain: Placement is the disposal of cash proceeds derived from illegal activities into the financial system (¶1.10(a)) — the first entry of dirty cash. Layering and integration come later; “refinancing” is not a stage of ML.

tc.q: 一名毒販攜帶大量現金到找換店兌換成另一貨幣，令該筆款項首次進入金融體系。這最能說明洗錢的哪個階段？
options: 存放
分層交易
整合
再融資
tc.explain: 「存放」指處置來自非法活動的現金得益並注入金融體系（第1.10(a)段），即黑錢首次進入金融體系。分層交易及整合屬較後階段；「再融資」並非洗錢階段。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1; AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.11
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.11段

en.q: Which statement about the statutory definition of “terrorist financing” is CORRECT?
options: It covers providing or collecting property intending or knowing it will be used to commit terrorist acts, whether or not the property is actually so used
It only applies where a terrorist act actually takes place
It only covers property derived from illegal sources
It only covers cross-border transfers made for terrorists
en.explain: TF under Sch. 1 includes the provision or collection of property with the intention or knowledge that it be used to commit terrorist acts — whether or not the property is actually so used. TF property can come from legitimate sources, and no completed terrorist act is required.

tc.q: 關於「恐怖分子資金籌集」的法定定義，下列哪項正確？
options: 涵蓋懷有將財產用於恐怖主義行為的意圖或知情而提供或籌集財產，不論該財產實際上有否被如此使用
只有在恐怖主義行為實際發生時才適用
只涵蓋來自非法來源的財產
只涵蓋為恐怖分子作出的跨境轉帳
tc.explain: 根據附表1，恐怖分子資金籌集包括懷有意圖或知道財產將用於作出恐怖主義行為而提供或籌集財產——不論該財產實際上有否被如此使用。有關財產可來自合法來源，亦無須有恐怖主義行為實際發生。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.1段

en.q: What is the key difference between money laundering (ML) and terrorist financing (TF)?
options: ML focuses on the source of the property, while TF focuses on the destination or use of the property, which may derive from legitimate sources
ML involves banks, while TF only involves money service operators
ML is a criminal offence, while TF attracts only disciplinary action
ML concerns cash only, while TF concerns electronic transfers only
en.explain: Per ¶6.1, ML is concerned with the handling of criminal proceeds — the source of property matters; the focus of TF is the destination or use of property, which may have derived from legitimate sources. Both are criminal offences.

tc.q: 洗錢與恐怖分子資金籌集的主要分別是甚麼？
options: 洗錢著重財產的來源；恐怖分子資金籌集的重心則在於財產的終點或用途，而有關財產可以來自合法來源
洗錢涉及銀行，恐怖分子資金籌集只涉及金錢服務經營者
洗錢屬刑事罪行，恐怖分子資金籌集只會招致紀律行動
洗錢只涉及現金，恐怖分子資金籌集只涉及電子轉帳
tc.explain: 根據第6.1段，洗錢著重處理犯罪得益，即財產來源是重點；恐怖分子資金籌集的重心則在於財產的終點或用途，而有關財產可以是從合法來源取得的。兩者均屬刑事罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.13段

en.q: Which of the following best describes the Financial Action Task Force (FATF)?
options: An inter-governmental body that sets international AML/CFT standards and monitors jurisdictions' compliance through evaluations
A United Nations agency that imposes binding financial sanctions on member states
The Hong Kong regulator responsible for licensing money service operators
An international court that prosecutes money laundering offences
en.explain: The FATF, formed in 1989, is an inter-governmental body that sets standards (the FATF Recommendations) for combating ML, TF and PF, and monitors compliance by conducting evaluations of jurisdictions (¶1.13). It is not a UN agency, a licensing regulator or a court.

tc.q: 下列哪項最能描述財務行動特別組織（FATF）？
options: 一個制訂打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集國際標準，並透過評核監察各司法管轄區合規情況的跨政府組織
一個對成員國施加具約束力金融制裁的聯合國機構
負責向金錢服務經營者發牌的香港監管機構
一個檢控洗錢罪行的國際法院
tc.explain: 特別組織於1989年成立，是跨政府組織，制訂打擊洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及擴散資金籌集的標準（特別組織建議），並透過評核監察各司法管轄區的合規情況（第1.13段）。它並非聯合國機構、發牌機構或法院。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.13段

en.q: As a member of the FATF, Hong Kong is obliged to do which of the following?
options: Implement the latest FATF Recommendations
Adopt the tax laws of other FATF members
Report all remittance transactions to the FATF
Obtain FATF approval before licensing each MSO
en.explain: As a FATF member, Hong Kong is obliged to implement the latest FATF Recommendations; complying with international AML/CFT standards helps maintain Hong Kong's status as an international financial centre (¶1.13). The FATF does not receive transaction reports or approve licences.

tc.q: 作為財務行動特別組織的成員，香港有責任做以下哪項？
options: 實施最新的特別組織建議
採納其他成員的稅務法例
向特別組織申報所有匯款交易
每次向金錢服務經營者發牌前先取得特別組織批准
tc.explain: 作為特別組織成員，香港有責任實施最新的特別組織建議；符合國際打擊洗錢標準有助維持香港作為國際金融中心的地位（第1.13段）。特別組織不接收交易申報，亦不參與發牌審批。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.14段

en.q: Which of the following correctly matches an ordinance with its chapter number?
options: Drug Trafficking (Recovery of Proceeds) Ordinance — Cap. 405
Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance — Cap. 575
United Nations (Anti-Terrorism Measures) Ordinance — Cap. 455
Weapons of Mass Destruction (Control of Provision of Services) Ordinance — Cap. 615
en.explain: The main AML/CFT-related legislation: AMLO (Cap. 615), DTROP (Cap. 405), OSCO (Cap. 455), UNATMO (Cap. 575), UNSO (Cap. 537) and WMD(CPS)O (Cap. 526). Only the DTROP pairing is correct.

tc.q: 下列哪項條例與其章數配對正確？
options: 《販毒（追討得益）條例》— 第405章
《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》— 第575章
《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》— 第455章
《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》— 第615章
tc.explain: 相關主要法例：《打擊洗錢條例》第615章、《販毒（追討得益）條例》第405章、《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第455章、《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第575章、《聯合國制裁條例》第537章、《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》第526章。只有《販毒（追討得益）條例》的配對正確。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.20段

en.q: Which of the following is a function of the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance (OSCO)?
options: Creating an offence of money laundering in relation to the proceeds of indictable offences
Establishing the licensing regime for money service operators
Imposing customer due diligence requirements on financial institutions
Implementing United Nations sanctions against places outside the PRC
en.explain: The OSCO, among other things, creates an offence of money laundering in relation to the proceeds of indictable offences, and gives investigation and confiscation powers (¶1.20). Licensing and CDD are under the AMLO; UN sanctions are implemented under the UNSO.

tc.q: 下列哪項是《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》的功能？
options: 就來自可公訴罪行的得益增訂一項洗錢罪行
設立金錢服務經營者發牌制度
對金融機構施加客戶盡職審查規定
實施聯合國對中華人民共和國以外地方的制裁
tc.explain: 《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》其中一項功能是增訂一項有關來自可公訴罪行得益的洗錢罪行，並賦予調查及沒收得益的權力（第1.20段）。發牌制度及盡職審查規定載於《打擊洗錢條例》；聯合國制裁則根據《聯合國制裁條例》實施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.21段

en.q: The United Nations (Anti-Terrorism Measures) Ordinance (UNATMO) is principally directed towards what?
options: Implementing UN Security Council decisions aimed at preventing the financing of terrorist acts and combating threats posed by foreign terrorist fighters
Recovering the proceeds of drug trafficking
Regulating the fees charged by money service operators
Controlling the export of strategic commodities from Hong Kong
en.explain: The UNATMO principally implements decisions in relevant UNSCRs aimed at preventing the financing of terrorist acts and combating threats posed by foreign terrorist fighters, plus pressing elements of the FATF Recommendations on TF (¶1.21).

tc.q: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》主要針對甚麼？
options: 實施聯合國安理會相關決議中，關於防止向恐怖主義行為提供資金和減低外國恐怖主義戰鬥人員威脅的決定
追討販毒活動的得益
規管金錢服務經營者的收費
管制策略物品從香港出口
tc.explain: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》旨在實施安理會相關決議中關於防止向恐怖主義行為提供資金和減低外國恐怖主義戰鬥人員威脅的決定，並實施特別組織建議中與恐怖分子資金籌集有關較具逼切性的部分（第1.21段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.26及6.7段

en.q: Under the United Nations Sanctions Ordinance (UNSO), who makes regulations to implement sanctions decided by the UN Security Council, and where are designated parties published?
options: The Chief Executive makes the regulations; designations are published in the Gazette or on the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau website
The Commissioner of Customs and Excise makes the regulations; designations are published on the C&ED website
The Secretary for Justice makes the regulations; designations are published by the courts
The Monetary Authority makes the regulations; designations are published in newspapers
en.explain: The UNSO empowers the Chief Executive to make regulations implementing UNSC sanctions, including targeted financial sanctions; designated persons and entities are specified by notice in the Gazette or on the CEDB website (¶6.7). Most UNSCRs are implemented in Hong Kong under the UNSO (¶1.26).

tc.q: 根據《聯合國制裁條例》，由誰訂立規例以執行聯合國安理會決定的制裁？被指認人士名單於何處公布？
options: 由行政長官訂立規例；被指認人士透過憲報或商務及經濟發展局網站的公告指明
由海關關長訂立規例；名單於海關網站公布
由律政司司長訂立規例；名單由法院公布
由金融管理專員訂立規例；名單於報章公布
tc.explain: 《聯合國制裁條例》授權行政長官訂立規例，以執行安理會決定的制裁（包括針對性金融制裁）；被指認的個人及實體透過在憲報或商務及經濟發展局網站刊登的公告指明（第6.7段）。在香港，大部分安理會決議均根據該條例實施（第1.26段）。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.27, ¶6.10; s.4 WMD(CPS)O
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.27及6.10段；《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》第4條

en.q: Section 4 of the Weapons of Mass Destruction (Control of Provision of Services) Ordinance prohibits a person from doing what?
options: Providing any services where he believes or suspects, on reasonable grounds, that the services may be connected to proliferation financing
Exporting any dual-use goods without a licence
Operating a money service without notifying the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
Holding funds for any customer from a high-risk jurisdiction
en.explain: s.4 WMD(CPS)O prohibits providing services where a person believes or suspects, on reasonable grounds, that the services may be connected to PF. “Services” is widely defined and includes lending money or other financial assistance (¶1.27, ¶6.10).

tc.q: 《大規模毀滅武器（提供服務的管制）條例》第4條禁止任何人作出甚麼行為？
options: 提供任何基於合理理由相信或懷疑可能與擴散資金籌集有關的服務
未領有許可證而出口兩用物品
未通知商務及經濟發展局而經營金錢服務
為任何來自高風險司法管轄區的客戶持有資金
tc.explain: 該條例第4條禁止任何人提供基於合理理由相信或懷疑可能與擴散資金籌集有關的服務。「提供服務」被廣泛界定，包括借出款項或以其他方式提供財政資助（第1.27及6.10段）。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.22; s.25 DTROP & OSCO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.22段；《販毒（追討得益）條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25條

en.q: Under the DTROP and the OSCO, a person who deals with property knowing or having reasonable grounds to believe it represents proceeds of drug trafficking or of an indictable offence faces what maximum penalty on conviction?
options: 14 years' imprisonment and a fine of $5 million
2 years' imprisonment and a fine of $1 million
3 years' imprisonment and a fine
3 months' imprisonment and a fine of $50,000
en.explain: The dealing offence under s.25 of the DTROP and the OSCO carries a maximum of 14 years' imprisonment and a $5 million fine (¶1.22). 2 years/$1M is the AMLO s.5 offence for knowing contravention; 3 years is tipping-off; 3 months/$50,000 is failure to disclose.

tc.q: 根據《販毒（追討得益）條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》，任何人知道或有合理理由相信財產代表販毒或可公訴罪行的得益而仍處理該財產，一經定罪，最高刑罰為何？
options: 監禁14年及罰款五百萬元
監禁2年及罰款一百萬元
監禁3年及罰款
監禁3個月及罰款50,000元
tc.explain: 兩條例第25條的處理犯罪得益罪行，一經定罪最高可判監禁14年及罰款五百萬元（第1.22段）。監禁2年／罰款一百萬元是《打擊洗錢條例》第5條明知違反的刑罰；監禁3年是「通風報訊」；監禁3個月／罰款50,000元是未有披露的罪行。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶1.24; s.25A DTROP & OSCO, s.12 & 14 UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.24段；《販毒條例》及《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A條、《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12及14條

en.q: A person who fails to disclose, as soon as reasonable, his knowledge or suspicion that property represents proceeds of drug trafficking, an indictable offence or terrorist property commits an offence. What is the maximum penalty?
options: 3 months' imprisonment and a fine of $50,000
3 years' imprisonment and a fine
14 years' imprisonment and a fine of $5 million
A disciplinary fine of $10 million
en.explain: Failure to disclose knowledge or suspicion under s.25A DTROP/OSCO and s.12/14 UNATMO carries a maximum of 3 months' imprisonment and a $50,000 fine (¶1.24). This is why suspicions must be reported promptly (via the MLRO to the JFIU).

tc.q: 任何人知悉或懷疑任何財產代表販毒或可公訴罪行的得益或屬恐怖分子財產，而未能在合理範圍內盡快披露，即屬犯罪。最高刑罰為何？
options: 監禁3個月及罰款50,000元
監禁3年及罰款
監禁14年及罰款五百萬元
繳付一千萬元紀律罰款
tc.explain: 根據《販毒條例》／《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》第25A條及《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第12及14條，未有披露知悉或懷疑的罪行最高可判監禁3個月及罰款50,000元（第1.24段）。因此必須盡快（經洗錢報告主任向聯合財富情報組）報告可疑情況。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第1.25段

en.q: Which of the following describes the offence of “tipping off”?
options: Knowing or suspecting that a disclosure has been made, disclosing to another person any matter likely to prejudice any investigation following that disclosure
Advising a customer on how to reduce remittance fees
Reporting a suspicious transaction to the JFIU without informing the customer
Disclosing an MSO's licence number to a business counterparty
en.explain: Tipping off is committed when a person, knowing or suspecting a disclosure (e.g. an STR) has been made, discloses any matter likely to prejudice the ensuing investigation (¶1.25). Maximum penalty: 3 years' imprisonment and a fine. Reporting to the JFIU itself is a duty, not an offence.

tc.q: 下列哪項描述「通風報訊」罪行？
options: 知道或懷疑已曾作出披露，而仍向其他人披露任何相當可能損害為跟進該披露而進行的調查的事宜
建議客戶如何減省匯款手續費
在不通知客戶的情況下向聯合財富情報組報告可疑交易
向業務夥伴披露金錢服務經營者的牌照號碼
tc.explain: 任何人知道或懷疑已曾作出披露（例如可疑交易報告），而仍向其他人披露任何相當可能損害相關調查的事宜，即犯「通風報訊」罪（第1.25段），最高刑罰為監禁3年及罰款。向聯合財富情報組報告本身是責任，並非罪行。

source.en: AML/CFT Guideline for MSOs (Jun 2023) ¶6.5(a); s.6 UNATMO
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.5(a)段；《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第6條

en.q: Under section 6 of the UNATMO, who is empowered to freeze suspected terrorist property?
options: The Secretary for Security
The Commissioner of Customs and Excise
The Joint Financial Intelligence Unit
The Financial Action Task Force
en.explain: Section 6 of the UNATMO empowers the Secretary for Security to freeze suspected terrorist property (¶6.5(a)). The S for S may also licence exceptions so frozen property can be unfrozen, e.g. for reasonable living or legal expenses (¶6.6).

tc.q: 根據《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第6條，誰獲授權凍結懷疑是恐怖分子的財產？
options: 保安局局長
海關關長
聯合財富情報組
財務行動特別組織
tc.explain: 《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》第6條授權保安局局長凍結懷疑是恐怖分子的財產（第6.5(a)段）。保安局局長亦可批予特許，准許已凍結財產解凍，例如支付合理生活或法律開支（第6.6段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）詞彙表；第6.18段

en.q: In Hong Kong's AML/CFT regime, suspicious transaction reports (STRs) should be made to which body?
options: The Joint Financial Intelligence Unit (JFIU)
The Financial Action Task Force (FATF)
The Commerce and Economic Development Bureau
The Companies Registry
en.explain: STRs are made to the JFIU. The C&ED/CCE is the MSO regulator and licensing authority, and the FATF is the international standard-setter — neither receives STRs.

tc.q: 在香港的打擊洗錢制度下，可疑交易報告應向哪個機構提交？
options: 聯合財富情報組
財務行動特別組織
商務及經濟發展局
公司註冊處
tc.explain: 可疑交易報告須向聯合財富情報組提交。海關／關長是金錢服務經營者的監管及發牌機構，特別組織則是國際標準制定者——兩者均不接收可疑交易報告。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.7段註57

en.q: “Targeted financial sanctions” refer to which of the following?
options: Both asset freezing and prohibitions to prevent funds or other assets from being made available for the benefit of designated persons and entities
Trade tariffs imposed on goods from sanctioned countries
Travel bans imposed on designated persons
Fines imposed by the FATF on non-compliant jurisdictions
en.explain: Targeted financial sanctions cover both asset freezing and prohibitions preventing funds or other assets from being made available, directly or indirectly, for the benefit of designated persons and entities (¶6.7, footnote 57).

tc.q: 「針對性金融制裁」指下列哪項？
options: 凍結資產，以及禁止向被指認的個人及實體的利益直接或間接提供資金或其他資產
對受制裁國家的貨物徵收貿易關稅
對被指認人士實施旅遊禁令
特別組織對不合規司法管轄區施加的罰款
tc.explain: 針對性金融制裁一併指凍結資產及禁止為被指認的個人及實體的利益而直接或間接提供資金或其他資產（第6.7段註57）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》（2023年6月）第6.9段

en.q: To combat proliferation financing, the UN Security Council adopts a two-tiered approach. Which of the following correctly describes it?
options: A global approach under UNSCR 1540, and a country-specific approach against the DPRK (UNSCR 1718) and Iran (UNSCR 2231)
A global approach under UNSCR 1267, and a country-specific approach against Al-Qaida and the Taliban
A regional approach led by the FATF, and a local approach led by each member state
A voluntary approach for developed countries and a mandatory approach for developing countries
en.explain: The UNSC combats PF through (a) a global approach under UNSCR 1540 (2004) and successors, and (b) a country-specific approach under UNSCR 1718 (2006) against the DPRK and UNSCR 2231 (2015) against Iran (¶6.9). UNSCR 1267 concerns terrorism designations, not PF.

tc.q: 為遏止擴散資金籌集，聯合國安理會採取雙層策略。下列哪項描述正確？
options: 在全球層面根據安理會第1540號決議；在國家層面根據針對朝鮮的第1718號決議及針對伊朗的第2231號決議
在全球層面根據安理會第1267號決議；在國家層面針對基地組織及塔利班
由特別組織主導的地區策略，以及由各成員國主導的本地策略
對已發展國家屬自願性質，對發展中國家屬強制性質
tc.explain: 安理會從兩個層面遏止擴散資金籌集：(a)全球層面——第1540 (2004)號決議及其後續決議；(b)國家層面——針對朝鮮的第1718 (2006)號決議及針對伊朗的第2231 (2015)號決議（第6.9段）。第1267號決議涉及恐怖分子指認，與擴散資金籌集無關。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》（第615章）第1至7部結構

en.q: Which Part of the AMLO contains the licensing regime for money service operators?
options: Part 5
Part 2
Part 3
Part 7
en.explain: Part 5 of the AMLO establishes the MSO licensing regime (register of licensees, restriction on operating without a licence, grant/renewal, approvals, duties and the Commissioner's disciplinary powers). Part 2 gives effect to Schedule 2; Part 3 contains the authorities' inspection and investigation powers; Part 7 is miscellaneous provisions.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》哪一部載有金錢服務經營者的發牌制度？
options: 第5部
第2部
第3部
第7部
tc.explain: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5部設立金錢服務經營者發牌制度（持牌人登記冊、無牌經營的限制、牌照批給與續期、批准事項、持牌人責任及關長的紀律權力）。第2部使附表2具有效力；第3部載有當局的查察及調查權力；第7部為雜項條文。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第25條

en.q: A licensed bank (authorized institution) offers currency exchange to its customers. Does it need an MSO licence under Part 5 of the AMLO?
options: No — Part 5 does not apply to an authorized institution
Yes — everyone offering currency exchange in Hong Kong needs an MSO licence
Yes, but only if the exchange volume exceeds $8,000 per day
No, provided it notifies the C&ED annually
en.explain: s.25: Part 5 does not apply to the Government or to an authorized institution, nor to certain licensed corporations, insurers, insurance intermediaries and SVF licensees operating a money service that is ancillary to their principal business — they are regulated by their own regulators.

tc.q: 一間持牌銀行（認可機構）向客戶提供貨幣兌換服務。它是否需要根據《打擊洗錢條例》第5部領取金錢服務經營者牌照？
options: 不需要——第5部不適用於認可機構
需要——在香港提供貨幣兌換的任何人均須領取金錢服務經營者牌照
需要，但只限每日兌換額超過8,000元
不需要，但須每年通知海關
tc.explain: 第25條：第5部不適用於政府及認可機構，亦不適用於經營附帶於其主要業務的金錢服務的若干持牌法團、保險人、保險中介人及儲值支付工具持牌人——他們由本身的監管機構規管。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(5)至(6)條

en.q: An MSO KNOWINGLY contravenes a specified provision of the AMLO. On conviction on indictment, what is the maximum penalty?
options: A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 7 years
A fine of $10,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine of $5,000,000 and imprisonment for 14 years
en.explain: s.5: a knowing contravention of a specified provision carries, on conviction on indictment, a fine of $1,000,000 and 2 years' imprisonment. The 7-year maximum applies where the contravention is committed with intent to defraud the relevant authority (the CCE for MSOs). $5M/14 years is the DTROP/OSCO dealing offence.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者「明知」而違反《打擊洗錢條例》的指明條文。循公訴程序定罪後，最高刑罰為何？
options: 罰款100萬元及監禁2年
罰款100萬元及監禁7年
罰款1,000萬元及監禁2年
罰款500萬元及監禁14年
tc.explain: 第5條：明知而違反指明條文，循公訴程序定罪，最高可處罰款100萬元及監禁2年。監禁7年適用於出於詐騙有關當局（就金錢服務經營者而言即關長）的意圖而違反的情況。罰款500萬元／監禁14年是《販毒條例》／《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》的處理犯罪得益罪行。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第5(6)條

en.q: When does the HIGHER maximum of 7 years' imprisonment apply to a contravention of a specified provision of the AMLO?
options: When the contravention is committed with intent to defraud the relevant authority (the CCE, for an MSO)
Whenever the amount involved exceeds $1,000,000
When the contravention is repeated more than three times
Whenever a customer suffers loss
en.explain: s.5(6): contravening a specified provision with intent to defraud the relevant authority carries a maximum of 7 years' imprisonment and a $1,000,000 fine. A merely knowing contravention carries up to 2 years.

tc.q: 在甚麼情況下，違反《打擊洗錢條例》指明條文適用監禁7年的較高刑罰上限？
options: 出於詐騙有關當局（就金錢服務經營者而言即關長）的意圖而違反指明條文
凡涉及金額超過100萬元
違反超過三次
凡有客戶蒙受損失
tc.explain: 第5(6)條：出於詐騙有關當局的意圖而違反指明條文，最高可處監禁7年及罰款100萬元。僅屬明知而違反則最高監禁2年。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第7條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第1.7至1.8段

en.q: Which statement about guidelines published by the CCE under section 7 of the AMLO is CORRECT?
options: Failure to comply with a guideline is not of itself an offence, but the guideline is admissible in evidence in proceedings under the AMLO and must be taken into account by the court where relevant
Breaching a guideline is automatically a criminal offence punishable by imprisonment
Guidelines are internal C&ED documents with no legal significance
Guidelines only apply to banks, not MSOs
en.explain: s.7 empowers the CCE to publish guidelines on the operation of Schedule 2. A failure to comply does not by itself render a person liable to proceedings, but the guideline is admissible in evidence, and a court must take relevant provisions into account; the CCE must have regard to them in considering contraventions of Schedule 2 (¶1.8).

tc.q: 關於關長根據《打擊洗錢條例》第7條公布的指引，下列哪項正確？
options: 不遵守指引本身不構成罪行，但指引在根據《打擊洗錢條例》提起的法律程序中可獲接納為證據；法院覺得指引條文攸關案中問題時須加以考慮
違反指引即自動構成可判監禁的刑事罪行
指引只是海關內部文件，並無法律意義
指引只適用於銀行，不適用於金錢服務經營者
tc.explain: 第7條授權關長就附表2的施行公布指引。不遵守指引本身不會令人在司法程序中被起訴，但指引可獲接納為證據；法院覺得指引條文攸關法律程序中的問題時，須在裁斷時加以考慮；關長考慮某人有否違反附表2時亦須顧及相關條文（第1.8段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第9條（第3部）

en.q: Under section 9 of the AMLO, what may an authorized person do for the purpose of a ROUTINE inspection of an MSO?
options: Enter the MSO's business premises at any reasonable time, inspect and copy business records, and make inquiries concerning them
Enter the MSO director's private residence without a warrant
Arrest any staff member on the spot
Seize the MSO's entire business for auction
en.explain: s.9 allows an authorized person, at any reasonable time, to enter business premises, inspect and make copies of specified business records, and make inquiries of the inspection subject (and, subject to limits, information holders) — to ascertain compliance with prescribed requirements. Entering domestic premises or seizure generally requires a magistrate's warrant (s.17).

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》第9條，獲授權人員為對金錢服務經營者作例行查察可以怎樣做？
options: 在任何合理時間進入其營業處所，查察及複製業務紀錄，並就有關紀錄作出查訊
無手令進入經營者董事的私人住所
即場拘捕任何職員
檢取整盤生意作拍賣
tc.explain: 第9條容許獲授權人員在任何合理時間進入業務處所、查察及複製指明業務紀錄，並向查察對象（及在限制下向資料持有人）作出查訊，以確定其有否遵守訂明規定。進入住宅處所或檢取物品一般須有裁判官手令（第17條）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第21條（第4部）

en.q: Under section 21 of the AMLO, if an MSO contravenes a specified provision, the maximum pecuniary penalty the CCE may order is:
options: The greater of $10,000,000 or 3 times the profit gained or costs avoided as a result of the contravention
$10,000 per day of contravention
Unlimited, at the CCE's discretion
en.explain: s.21(2)(c): the disciplinary pecuniary penalty for contravening a specified provision must not exceed the greater of $10 million or 3 times the profit gained or costs avoided. The other s.21 powers are public reprimand and remedial orders. (Contrast s.43: penalties for licence-condition/administrative contraventions are capped at $1,000,000.)

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》第21條，如金錢服務經營者違反指明條文，關長可命令繳付的罰款最高為：
options: 1,000萬元，或因違反而獲取的利潤或避免的開支的3倍，以較大者為準
劃一100萬元
每日違反10,000元
不設上限，由關長酌情決定
tc.explain: 第21(2)(c)條：就違反指明條文施加的罰款，不得超過1,000萬元或因違反而獲取的利潤／避免的開支的3倍（以較大者為準）。第21條的其他權力為公開譴責及補救令。（對照第43條：違反牌照條件／行政規定的罰款上限為100萬元。）

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第29條

en.q: A person operates a remittance business in Hong Kong without an MSO licence. Which statement is CORRECT?
options: They commit an offence — on conviction on indictment, a fine of $1,000,000 and 2 years' imprisonment, and the court may disqualify them from holding a licence
No offence is committed unless a customer complains
They commit an offence only if they also launder money
The only consequence is a warning letter from the C&ED
en.explain: s.29: operating a money service without a licence is an offence — on indictment, a $1,000,000 fine and 2 years' imprisonment (summary: level 6 fine and 6 months). The court may also order disqualification from holding a licence for a specified period.

tc.q: 某人未持有金錢服務經營者牌照而在香港經營匯款業務。下列哪項正確？
options: 即屬犯罪——循公訴程序定罪可處罰款100萬元及監禁2年，法院並可命令取消其持有牌照的資格
除非有客戶投訴，否則不構成罪行
只有同時洗錢才構成罪行
唯一後果是海關發出警告信
tc.explain: 第29條：無牌照經營金錢服務即屬犯罪——循公訴程序定罪可處罰款100萬元及監禁2年（循簡易程序：第6級罰款及監禁6個月）。法院並可命令該人在指明期間內喪失持有牌照的資格。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第30(3)條

en.q: Before granting an MSO licence to a corporate applicant, the Commissioner must be satisfied of what?
options: That each director is a fit and proper person to be associated with the money service business, that any ultimate owner is fit and proper, and that any particular premises are suitable
Only that the company has sufficient capital
Only that the company has passed the Competence Assessment
That the company holds a banking licence
en.explain: s.30(3): for a corporation, the CCE may grant a licence only if satisfied that each director and any ultimate owner is a fit and proper person, and — where the application covers particular premises — that the premises are suitable for operating a money service. (For individuals/partnerships, the individual or each partner must be fit and proper.)

tc.q: 向法團申請人批出金錢服務經營者牌照前，關長必須信納甚麼？
options: 每名董事均屬與經營金錢服務業務有聯繫的適當人選、任何最終擁有人亦屬適當人選；如申請涉及特定處所，該處所適合用於經營金錢服務
只須信納公司有充足資本
只須信納公司已通過能力評核
公司持有銀行牌照
tc.explain: 第30(3)條：就法團而言，關長只有在信納每名董事及任何最終擁有人均屬適當人選，及（如申請涉及特定處所）該處所適合經營金錢服務時，方可批出牌照。（個人／合夥申請人則須本人／每名合夥人屬適當人選。）

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第31(2)(a)條

en.q: By when must an application to renew an MSO licence be made?
options: Not later than 45 days before the licence is due to expire
Not later than 7 days before expiry
Any time within 30 days after expiry
Not later than 6 months before expiry
en.explain: s.31(2)(a): a renewal application must be made not later than 45 days before the licence is due to expire, in the specified form and with the Schedule 3 fee. On renewal the CCE may amend, remove or impose licence conditions.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者牌照的續期申請最遲須於何時提出？
options: 牌照期滿前不少於45日
期滿前不少於7日
期滿後30日內任何時間
期滿前不少於6個月
tc.explain: 第31(2)(a)條：續期申請最遲須於牌照期滿前45日以指明格式提出，並繳付附表3訂明的費用。續期時關長可修改、取消或新增牌照條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第34條

en.q: On which ground may the Commissioner revoke or suspend an MSO licence?
options: The licensee (or a partner, director or ultimate owner) is no longer a fit and proper person
The licensee's profits have declined
The licensee has changed its bank
The licensee employs fewer than five staff
en.explain: s.34: the CCE may revoke or suspend a licence where, among other grounds, the licensee — or any partner, any director, or any ultimate owner — is no longer a fit and proper person, or where consent for licensed domestic premises is revoked. Commercial performance is not a ground.

tc.q: 關長可基於下列哪項理由撤銷或暫時吊銷金錢服務經營者牌照？
options: 持牌人（或其合夥人、董事或最終擁有人）不再屬適當人選
持牌人的利潤下跌
持牌人轉用另一間銀行
持牌人僱員少於五人
tc.explain: 第34條：如持牌人——或任何合夥人、任何董事或任何最終擁有人——不再屬適當人選，或持牌住宅處所的佔用人撤回書面同意等，關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照。商業表現並非理由。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第35至37條

en.q: A licensed MSO (a corporation) wants to appoint a new director. What does the AMLO require?
options: The person must not become a director unless the Commissioner has, on the licensee's application, given prior approval in writing
The appointment may proceed, with notification to the CCE within one month afterwards
No approval or notification is required for directors
Approval is needed only if the director will own more than 50% of shares
en.explain: s.35(1): in relation to a corporate licensee, a person must not become a director unless the CCE has given written approval on the licensee's application (fee: $945 per person under Schedule 3). Similar prior-approval requirements apply to proposed ultimate owners (s.36) and partners (s.37). This is prior approval — not mere after-the-event notification.

tc.q: 一間持牌金錢服務經營者（法團）擬委任新董事。《打擊洗錢條例》有何規定？
options: 除非關長已應持牌人的申請事先給予書面批准，否則該人不得成為董事
可先行委任，事後一個月內通知關長
董事委任無須批准或通知
只有該董事將持有超過50%股份時才須批准
tc.explain: 第35(1)條：就法團持牌人而言，除非關長已應持牌人的申請給予書面批准，否則任何人不得成為其董事（附表3訂明費用為每人945元）。擬成為最終擁有人（第36條）及合夥人（第37條）亦須事先批准。這是事先批准——並非事後通知。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第39A條

en.q: What must a licensee do with its licence at the premises specified in the licence?
options: Display the ORIGINAL of the licence in a conspicuous place at the specified premises
Keep the licence locked in a safe off-site
Display a photocopy only, keeping the original at the company secretary's office
Display it only during C&ED inspections
en.explain: s.39A: a licensee licensed to operate at specified premises must display the original of the licence in a conspicuous place at those premises. Contravention without reasonable excuse is an offence (fine at level 5).

tc.q: 持牌人在牌照指明的處所須如何處理其牌照？
options: 在指明處所的顯眼位置展示牌照正本
將牌照鎖在其他地點的夾萬內
只展示影印本，正本存放於公司秘書辦事處
只在海關查察期間展示
tc.explain: 第39A條：獲發牌在指明處所經營金錢服務的持牌人，必須在該處所的顯眼位置展示牌照正本。無合理辯解而違反即屬犯罪（可處第5級罰款）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第40(1)條

en.q: There is a change in the particulars a licensee provided with its licence application. Within what period must the licensee notify the Commissioner?
options: In writing within one month beginning on the date the change takes place
Orally within 48 hours
In writing within six months
No notification is needed until the next renewal
en.explain: s.40(1): the licensee must notify the CCE in writing of any change in the particulars within one month beginning on the date on which the change takes place (the Licensing Guide prescribes Form 6). Contravention without reasonable excuse is an offence (level 5 fine).

tc.q: 持牌人早前隨牌照申請提供的資料有所變更。持牌人須在多久內通知關長？
options: 自變更發生當日起計一個月內以書面通知
48小時內口頭通知
六個月內以書面通知
毋須通知，待下次續期時一併處理
tc.explain: 第40(1)條：持牌人須自變更發生當日起計一個月內，以書面將資料變更通知關長（《牌照指引》訂明使用表格6）。無合理辯解而違反即屬犯罪（第5級罰款）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第41(1)條

en.q: A licensee intends to cease operating its money service. What does section 41 of the AMLO require?
options: Notify the Commissioner in writing of the intention and the cessation date BEFORE that date, and return the licence for cancellation within 7 days beginning on the cessation date
Simply stop operating — the licence lapses automatically
Notify the Commissioner within 3 months after ceasing
Sell the licence to another operator
en.explain: s.41(1): before the date of cessation, the licensee must notify the CCE in writing of the intention and the date (the Licensing Guide prescribes Form 7), and must return the licence for cancellation or amendment within 7 days beginning on the cessation date. Licences are not transferable.

tc.q: 持牌人有意停止經營金錢服務。《打擊洗錢條例》第41條有何規定？
options: 須在停業日期前以書面將意向及停業日期通知關長，並自停業日期起計7日內交回牌照以供註銷
直接停業即可——牌照自動失效
停業後3個月內通知關長
將牌照轉售予另一經營者
tc.explain: 第41(1)條：持牌人須在停業日期之前以書面將停業意向及日期通知關長（《牌照指引》訂明使用表格7），並自停業日期起計7日內交回牌照以供註銷或修訂。牌照不得轉讓。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第43條

en.q: A licensee breaches a condition of its licence (not a specified provision). Under section 43, what disciplinary actions may the Commissioner take?
options: Public reprimand, an order to take remedial action, and/or a pecuniary penalty not exceeding $1,000,000 (plus up to $10,000 daily for continued failure to remedy)
A pecuniary penalty of up to $10,000,000 or 3 times the profit gained
Immediate imprisonment of the directors
Confiscation of all the licensee's assets
en.explain: s.43: for contraventions of regulations, licence conditions or ss.35–41 duties, the CCE may publicly reprimand, order remedial action, and/or order a pecuniary penalty of up to $1,000,000 — plus a daily penalty of up to $10,000 for failing to comply with a remedial order. The $10M/3× penalty under s.21 applies to contraventions of specified provisions, not licence conditions.

tc.q: 持牌人違反牌照條件（並非指明條文）。根據第43條，關長可採取哪些紀律行動？
options: 公開譴責、命令採取補救行動，及／或命令繳付不超過100萬元的罰款（如未遵從補救令，另可每日罰款最多10,000元）
罰款最高1,000萬元或所獲利潤的3倍
立即監禁各董事
沒收持牌人全部資產
tc.explain: 第43條：就違反規例、牌照條件或第35至41條的責任，關長可公開譴責、命令補救，及／或命令繳付不超過100萬元的罰款；如未有遵從補救令，另可命令按日繳付不超過10,000元的罰款。第21條的1,000萬元／3倍利潤罰款適用於違反指明條文，而非牌照條件。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第52條

en.q: In its licence application, a company knowingly states false information about its ultimate owner. What is the consequence under the AMLO?
options: It commits an offence — knowingly or recklessly making a materially false or misleading statement (or omitting a material particular) in connection with a licence application is criminal
Nothing, provided the licence is eventually refused
Only a civil claim by the C&ED for costs
The application fee is doubled
en.explain: s.52: a person commits an offence if, in connection with an application for the grant or renewal of a licence, they make a statement false or misleading in a material particular (or omit a material particular) knowingly or recklessly. Providing false information also reflects on fitness and properness.

tc.q: 一間公司在牌照申請中明知而就其最終擁有人提供虛假資料。根據《打擊洗錢條例》會有何後果？
options: 即屬犯罪——明知或罔顧實情地在牌照申請中作出在要項上屬虛假或具誤導性的陳述（或遺漏要項），屬刑事罪行
只要申請最終被拒絕，便無後果
海關只可循民事途徑追討費用
申請費加倍
tc.explain: 第52條：任何人在牌照批給或續期申請中，明知或罔顧實情地作出在要項上屬虛假或具誤導性的陳述（或遺漏要項），即屬犯罪。提供虛假資料亦影響其是否屬適當人選。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第53條

en.q: Within what period may proceedings for a non-indictable offence under Part 5 of the AMLO be instituted?
options: Within 12 months after the offence is discovered by, or comes to the notice of, the Commissioner
Within 6 months after the offence is committed, with no exceptions
Within 7 years after the offence is committed
There is no time limit for any offence
en.explain: s.53: despite s.26 of the Magistrates Ordinance, proceedings for a non-indictable offence under Part 5 may be instituted within 12 months after the offence is discovered by or comes to the notice of the Commissioner.

tc.q: 就《打擊洗錢條例》第5部下非可公訴的罪行，可在多久內提出檢控？
options: 在關長發現該罪行或該罪行引起關長注意後12個月內
罪行發生後6個月內，並無例外
罪行發生後7年內
任何罪行均無時限
tc.explain: 第53條：即使有《裁判官條例》第26條的規定，就第5部下非可公訴的罪行，仍可在關長發現該罪行或該罪行引起其注意後12個月內提出檢控。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第6部、第59條

en.q: An applicant is aggrieved by the Commissioner's decision to refuse its MSO licence. What recourse does the AMLO provide?
options: Apply to the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Review Tribunal for a review within 21 days after the notice of the decision is sent
Appeal directly to the Chief Executive within 7 days
No recourse — the Commissioner's decisions are final
Petition the FATF for arbitration
en.explain: Part 6 establishes the AML/CFT Review Tribunal, which reviews specified decisions. For MSO decisions the specified authority is the Commissioner. An aggrieved person may apply for review within 21 days after the notice of the decision is sent (s.59(1)); the Tribunal may extend time.

tc.q: 申請人不服關長拒絕批出金錢服務經營者牌照的決定。《打擊洗錢條例》提供甚麼救濟途徑？
options: 在決定通知發出後21日內，向打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集覆核審裁處申請覆核
7日內直接向行政長官上訴
沒有救濟途徑——關長的決定為最終決定
請求財務行動特別組織仲裁
tc.explain: 第6部設立打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集覆核審裁處，覆核指明決定。就金錢服務經營者的決定而言，指明當局為關長。感到受屈的人可在決定通知發出後21日內申請覆核（第59(1)條）；審裁處可延展時限。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》第27至28條

en.q: Which statement about the register of MSO licensees is CORRECT?
options: The Commissioner must maintain a register of licensees, and certified copies of entries can be obtained on payment of the Schedule 3 fee
The register is a confidential internal C&ED database with no public access
The register is maintained by the Companies Registry
Each MSO maintains its own register and files it annually
en.explain: s.27 requires the Commissioner to maintain a register of licensees; s.28 provides for certified copies of entries or extracts (Schedule 3 fee: $160 per copy). The register lets the public verify whether an operator is licensed — the Licensing Guide explains what it contains and where it can be inspected.

tc.q: 關於金錢服務經營者持牌人登記冊，下列哪項正確？
options: 關長必須備存持牌人登記冊；繳付附表3訂明費用後可取得登記冊記項的核證副本
登記冊屬海關內部機密資料庫，公眾不得查閱
登記冊由公司註冊處備存
各經營者自行備存登記冊並每年提交
tc.explain: 第27條規定關長須備存持牌人登記冊；第28條訂明可取得記項或摘錄的核證副本（附表3費用：每份160元）。登記冊讓公眾查證經營者是否持牌——《牌照指引》解釋其內容及查閱途徑。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2及3部

en.q: Which parts of Schedule 2 to the AMLO contain the customer due diligence and record-keeping requirements respectively?
options: Part 2 contains the CDD requirements; Part 3 contains the record-keeping requirements
Part 1 contains CDD; Part 2 contains record-keeping
Part 3 contains CDD; Part 4 contains record-keeping
Both are in Schedule 1
en.explain: Schedule 2 is the core operational schedule: Part 1 is interpretation, Part 2 sets out the CDD requirements and Part 3 the record-keeping requirements. Section 23 of Schedule 2 requires safeguards to prevent contraventions of Parts 2 and 3.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2哪些部分分別載有客戶盡職審查及備存紀錄的規定？
options: 第2部載有盡職審查規定；第3部載有備存紀錄規定
第1部載有盡職審查；第2部載有備存紀錄
第3部載有盡職審查；第4部載有備存紀錄
兩者均載於附表1
tc.explain: 附表2是核心運作附表：第1部為釋義，第2部載列客戶盡職審查規定，第3部載列備存紀錄規定。附表2第23條規定須設保障措施，防止違反第2及3部的規定。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條

en.q: Where in the AMLO are the statutory definitions of “money laundering” and “terrorist financing” found?
options: Section 1 of Part 1 of Schedule 1
Section 1 of Schedule 2
Part 5 of the main body
Schedule 3
en.explain: The definitions of ML and TF (and of money service, money changing service and remittance service) are in Schedule 1, Part 1. Schedule 2 carries the CDD/record-keeping regime and its own interpretation section; Schedule 3 lists fees.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》中「洗錢」及「恐怖分子資金籌集」的法定定義載於何處？
options: 附表1第1部第1條
附表2第1條
主體條文第5部
附表3
tc.explain: 「洗錢」及「恐怖分子資金籌集」的定義（以及金錢服務、貨幣兌換服務及匯款服務的定義）載於附表1第1部。附表2載有盡職審查／備存紀錄制度及其本身的釋義條文；附表3則列明費用。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3（經修訂，2026年5月15日生效）

en.q: Schedule 3 to the AMLO sets out what?
options: The fees payable for MSO licence applications and related matters — e.g. $3,810 for a licence grant application (from 15 May 2026)
The list of countries subject to sanctions
The seven modules of the Competence Assessment
The maximum penalties for money laundering offences
en.explain: Schedule 3 prescribes the fees for licensing matters: e.g. grant of licence $3,810 (plus $2,440 per additional business premises and $945 per person subject to the fit-and-proper test), renewal $910, and $945 per person for director/ultimate owner/partner approvals — figures as amended with effect from 15 May 2026.

tc.q: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表3載列甚麼？
options: 金錢服務經營者牌照申請及相關事項的費用——例如牌照批給申請費3,810元（2026年5月15日起）
受制裁國家名單
能力評核的七個單元
洗錢罪行的最高刑罰
tc.explain: 附表3訂明發牌事項的費用：例如牌照批給申請3,810元（每個額外營業處所另加2,440元；每名須接受適當人選審查的人另加945元）、續期910元，以及董事／最終擁有人／合夥人批准申請每人945元——以上為2026年5月15日起生效的修訂數額。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條

en.q: Under the AMLO, “money service” means what?
options: A money changing service or a remittance service
Any service involving the handling of cash
Banking and deposit-taking services
Securities dealing and asset management services
en.explain: Schedule 1 defines money service as (a) a money changing service, or (b) a remittance service. Banking, securities and insurance activities are regulated separately under their own regimes.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》，「金錢服務」指甚麼？
options: 貨幣兌換服務或匯款服務
任何涉及處理現金的服務
銀行及接受存款服務
證券交易及資產管理服務
tc.explain: 附表1將金錢服務界定為(a)貨幣兌換服務；或(b)匯款服務。銀行、證券及保險業務由各自的制度另行規管。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definition of remittance service)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（匯款服務的定義）

en.q: Which statement about the statutory definition of a “remittance service” is CORRECT?
options: It covers, as a business in Hong Kong, sending (or arranging the sending of) money OUT of Hong Kong AND receiving (or arranging the receipt of) money FROM a place outside Hong Kong
It only covers sending money out of Hong Kong
It only covers transfers within Hong Kong
It covers any electronic payment between Hong Kong bank accounts
en.explain: The Schedule 1 definition covers a service operated in Hong Kong as a business of sending or arranging the sending of money to a place outside Hong Kong, receiving or arranging the receipt of money from outside Hong Kong (and related arrangements). Both directions are covered.

tc.q: 關於「匯款服務」的法定定義，下列哪項正確？
options: 涵蓋在香港作為業務經營的：將款項（或安排將款項）移離香港，以及自香港以外地方收取（或安排收取）款項
只涵蓋將款項匯出香港
只涵蓋香港境內的轉帳
涵蓋香港銀行戶口之間的任何電子支付
tc.explain: 附表1的定義涵蓋在香港作為業務經營的下述服務：將款項傳送或安排傳送至香港以外地方；自香港以外地方收取或安排收取款項（及相關安排）。匯出與匯入兩個方向均涵蓋在內。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 1, Part 1, s.1 (definition of money changing service)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表1第1部第1條（貨幣兌換服務的定義）

en.q: A hotel operates a currency exchange counter inside the hotel primarily for the convenience of its guests. Is this a “money changing service” under the AMLO?
options: No — the definition expressly excludes an exchange service operated by a hotel manager within the hotel primarily for guests' convenience
Yes — all currency exchange in Hong Kong falls within the definition
Yes, but only if the hotel has more than 100 rooms
No, because hotels are supervised by the HKMA
en.explain: The Schedule 1 definition of money changing service covers currency exchange operated in Hong Kong as a business, but expressly excludes a service operated by a person who manages a hotel where the service is operated within the hotel premises primarily for the convenience of guests and consists solely of buying non-Hong Kong currencies in exchange for Hong Kong currency.

tc.q: 一間酒店在店內設貨幣兌換櫃位，主要為方便住客。這是否《打擊洗錢條例》所指的「貨幣兌換服務」？
options: 不是——定義明文豁除酒店管理人在酒店處所內主要為方便住客而經營的兌換服務
是——香港所有貨幣兌換均屬定義範圍
是，但只限房間數目超過100間的酒店
不是，因為酒店由金融管理專員監管
tc.explain: 附表1「貨幣兌換服務」的定義涵蓋在香港作為業務經營的貨幣兌換服務，但明文豁除由管理酒店的人經營、在酒店處所內主要為方便住客而設，且只包含以港幣購買非香港貨幣交易的兌換服務。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1 (definition of business relationship)
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1條（業務關係的定義）

en.q: Under Schedule 2, what distinguishes a “business relationship” from an occasional dealing?
options: A business relationship is a business, professional or commercial relationship with an element of duration (or expected duration at first contact)
A business relationship requires a minimum of ten transactions
A business relationship exists only where a written contract is signed
A business relationship requires transactions above $120,000
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.1: a business relationship is a business, professional or commercial relationship that has an element of duration, or that the institution expects to have an element of duration when the person first contacts it as a potential customer. An occasional transaction is one with a customer who has no business relationship with the MSO.

tc.q: 根據附表2，「業務關係」與偶然交易的分別在於甚麼？
options: 業務關係是具持續性質（或在首次接觸時預期具持續性質）的業務、專業或商業關係
業務關係須有最少十宗交易
只有簽署書面合約才構成業務關係
業務關係須涉及120,000元以上的交易
tc.explain: 附表2第1條：業務關係指具持續元素的業務、專業或商業關係，或在該人首次以潛在客戶身分接觸金融機構時，該機構預期具持續元素的關係。非經常交易則指與該機構並無業務關係的客戶進行的交易。

source.en: AMLO Sch. 2, s.1 (definition of occasional transaction); AML/CFT Guideline ¶4.2.3
source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第1條（非經常交易的定義）；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.2.3段

en.q: Under Schedule 2 to the AMLO, an “occasional transaction” is:
options: A transaction between an MSO and a customer who does NOT have a business relationship with the MSO
Any transaction below $8,000
Any transaction conducted less than once a month
A transaction conducted outside normal business hours
en.explain: An occasional transaction is defined as a transaction between the MSO and a customer who does not have a business relationship with the MSO (e.g. a walk-in exchange or remittance customer). CDD thresholds of $120,000 / $8,000 (wire and VA transfers) attach to occasional transactions.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢條例》附表2，「非經常交易」是指：
options: 金錢服務經營者與跟它並無業務關係的客戶之間進行的交易
任何低於8,000元的交易
每月少於一次的交易
在正常營業時間以外進行的交易
tc.explain: 非經常交易的定義是金錢服務經營者與跟它並無業務關係的客戶之間的交易（例如街客的兌換或匯款交易）。120,000元／8,000元（電傳轉帳及虛擬資產轉移）的盡職審查門檻正是就非經常交易而設。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第3(1)條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.2.4至4.2.5段

en.q: A walk-in customer sends three wire transfers of $3,000 each to the same recipient within an hour. What does Schedule 2 require?
options: CDD must be carried out — the $8,000 threshold applies to several operations that appear to the MSO to be linked, and $9,000 in linked transfers exceeds it
Nothing — each transaction is below $8,000
Only a record of the last transaction
CDD is only needed if the customer looks suspicious
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.3(1): the occasional-transaction thresholds apply whether the transaction is carried out in a single operation or in several operations that appear to the MSO to be linked. Three linked $3,000 wire transfers total $9,000 — above the $8,000 wire-transfer threshold — so CDD must be carried out (¶4.2.4–4.2.5).

tc.q: 一名街客在一小時內向同一收款人先後發出三筆各3,000元的電傳轉帳。附表2有何規定？
options: 必須執行盡職審查——8,000元門檻適用於在經營者看來互有關連的多項交易，而互有關連的轉帳合共9,000元已超過門檻
毋須任何行動——每筆交易均低於8,000元
只須記錄最後一筆交易
只有客戶形跡可疑時才須盡職審查
tc.explain: 附表2第3(1)條：非經常交易門檻適用於以單一交易進行或以在經營者看來互有關連的多項交易進行的情況。三筆互有關連的3,000元電傳轉帳合共9,000元，已超過電傳轉帳8,000元的門檻，故必須執行盡職審查（第4.2.4至4.2.5段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第2(1)(a)至(b)條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.4.1及4.4.3段

en.q: Under Schedule 2, how do the verification standards differ between a customer and a beneficial owner?
options: The customer's identity must be verified; for a beneficial owner, the MSO must take REASONABLE MEASURES to verify identity so that it is satisfied it knows who the beneficial owner is
Both must be verified to exactly the same standard in all cases
Beneficial owners never need any verification
Only beneficial owners need verification; customers do not
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.2(1): the customer must be identified and verified using reliable and independent documents, data or information; for a beneficial owner, the MSO must identify them and take reasonable measures to verify their identity — a risk-sensitive standard (¶4.4.3), including understanding the ownership and control structure of legal persons and trusts.

tc.q: 根據附表2，對客戶與對實益擁有人的身分核實標準有何分別？
options: 客戶的身分必須核實；對實益擁有人則須採取「合理措施」核實其身分，使經營者信納它知道實益擁有人是誰
兩者在任何情況下均須以完全相同的標準核實
實益擁有人從來無須任何核實
只須核實實益擁有人，客戶無須核實
tc.explain: 附表2第2(1)條：客戶必須以可靠而獨立的文件、數據或資料識別及核實身分；對實益擁有人，則須識別並採取合理措施核實其身分——此為按風險而定的標準（第4.4.3段），包括了解法人或信託的擁有權及控制權架構。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第4(3)條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.8.10段

en.q: For which customer may an MSO choose NOT to identify and verify the beneficial owners under section 4 of Schedule 2?
options: A corporation listed on a stock exchange
Any private company incorporated in Hong Kong
Any customer introduced by an existing customer
A company whose director is personally known to the MSO's owner
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.4(3) permits skipping beneficial-owner identification/verification for specific customers: an FI as defined in the AMLO (or equivalent overseas institution), a corporation listed on any stock exchange, certain investment vehicles, the Government or a public body in Hong Kong, and equivalent-jurisdiction governments/public bodies (¶4.8.10). Ordinary private companies enjoy no such exemption.

tc.q: 根據附表2第4條，金錢服務經營者可就哪類客戶選擇不識別及核實其實益擁有人？
options: 在證券交易所上市的法團
任何在香港註冊成立的私人公司
任何由現有客戶介紹的客戶
其董事與經營者東主相熟的公司
tc.explain: 附表2第4(3)條准許就特定客戶不識別／核實實益擁有人：《打擊洗錢條例》所界定的金融機構（或對等司法管轄區的類似機構）、在任何證券交易所上市的法團、若干投資工具、香港政府或公共機構，以及對等司法管轄區的政府／公共機構（第4.8.10段）。一般私人公司並無此豁免。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第5(1)條

en.q: Section 5 of Schedule 2 requires an MSO to continuously monitor its business relationships. Which duties does it impose?
options: Reviewing CDD documents and information to keep them up-to-date; scrutinising transactions for consistency with the customer's profile; and examining (with written findings) complex, unusually large or unusual-pattern transactions with no apparent economic or lawful purpose
Auditing the customer's financial statements every year
Visiting each customer's business premises quarterly
Requiring customers to re-submit identity documents every month
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.5(1) requires ongoing monitoring: keeping CDD documents, data and information up-to-date and relevant; scrutinising transactions for consistency with the MSO's knowledge of the customer; and identifying and examining complex, unusually large or unusual-pattern transactions with no apparent economic or lawful purpose, setting out findings in writing.

tc.q: 附表2第5條規定金錢服務經營者須對業務關係作持續監察。它施加了哪些責任？
options: 不時覆核盡職審查文件及資料以確保反映現況；審察交易是否與對客戶的認識相符；並審查（連同書面載述審查結果）複雜、異常龐大或模式異常且無明顯經濟或合法目的的交易
每年審計客戶的財務報表
每季探訪每名客戶的營業處所
要求客戶每月重新提交身分證明文件
tc.explain: 附表2第5(1)條規定持續監察：確保盡職審查文件、數據及資料反映現況及切合需要；審察交易是否與經營者對客戶的認識相符；以及識別並審查複雜、金額異常龐大或模式異常且無明顯經濟或合法目的的交易，並以書面載述審查結果。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第6條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第4.12.1段

en.q: When must CDD be carried out for a PRE-EXISTING customer (relationship established before the AMLO commenced on 1 April 2012)?
options: When an unusual or suspicious transaction occurs, a material change occurs in the way the account is operated, ML/TF is suspected, or the veracity of previously obtained identification information is doubted
Never — pre-existing customers are permanently exempt from CDD
Only when the customer voluntarily offers new documents
Every month, regardless of circumstances
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.6 (¶4.12.1): CDD must be performed for pre-existing customers when (a) an unusual/suspicious transaction inconsistent with the MSO's knowledge of the customer takes place; (b) a material change occurs in the way the account is operated; (c) ML/TF is suspected; or (d) the MSO doubts the veracity or adequacy of previously obtained identification information. Ongoing monitoring also applies to them.

tc.q: 就「既有客戶」（在《打擊洗錢條例》2012年4月1日生效前已建立關係的客戶），何時必須執行盡職審查？
options: 出現異常或可疑交易、帳戶運作方式出現重大改變、懷疑涉及洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集，或對先前取得的身分資料的真實性有疑問時
永遠無須——既有客戶永久豁免盡職審查
只有客戶自願提供新文件時
不論情況如何，每月一次
tc.explain: 附表2第6條（第4.12.1段）：就既有客戶，在下列情況必須執行盡職審查：(a)發生金額或性質異常或可疑、與經營者對客戶認識不符的交易；(b)帳戶運作方式出現重大改變；(c)懷疑涉及洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集；或(d)對先前為識別或核實身分而取得的資料的真實性或充分性有疑問。持續監察規定亦適用於既有客戶。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第9(1)至(2)條

en.q: Section 9(1) of Schedule 2 deals with customers not physically present for identification. Which statement is CORRECT?
options: At least one prescribed additional measure must be carried out to mitigate the risk — unless identity was verified through a digital identification system recognised by the CCE as a reliable and independent source
Non-face-to-face customers are prohibited entirely
The MSO may simply skip verification for online customers
The additional measures are only recommended, never required
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.9(1) requires at least one additional measure for customers not physically present (further verification from unused sources; supplementary verification measures; or first payment through an account in the customer's name with an authorized institution or equivalent). s.9(2): verification via a CCE-recognised digital identification system dispenses with the additional measures.

tc.q: 附表2第9(1)條處理並非親身在場接受身分識別的客戶。下列哪項正確？
options: 必須執行最少一項訂明的額外措施以減低風險——除非已透過關長認可為可靠及獨立來源的數碼識別系統核實身分
完全禁止非親身在場的客戶
網上客戶可直接略過身分核實
額外措施只屬建議，從非強制
tc.explain: 附表2第9(1)條規定，就並非親身在場的客戶，必須執行最少一項額外措施（以未用過的來源進一步核實身分；採取補充核實措施；或首筆付款須經以客戶名義於認可機構或同類機構開立的帳戶進行）。第9(2)條：如經關長認可的數碼識別系統核實身分，則無須執行額外措施。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第10及15條

en.q: Which sections of Schedule 2 provide the statutory basis for enhanced due diligence on non-Hong Kong PEPs and on high-risk situations respectively?
options: Section 10 (non-Hong Kong PEPs) and section 15 (high-risk situations, including those specified by the CCE)
Section 5 and section 6
Section 20 and section 21
Section 12 and section 13
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.10 imposes the mandatory EDD measures for customers/beneficial owners who are non-Hong Kong PEPs (senior management approval, source of wealth/funds, enhanced monitoring); s.15 requires special/enhanced measures in situations that by their nature present a high ML/TF risk or as specified by the CCE. s.5 is ongoing monitoring; s.12/13 are wire transfers and remittance; s.20/21 are records.

tc.q: 附表2哪些條文分別為對非香港政治人物及對高風險情況採取更嚴格盡職審查提供法定依據？
options: 第10條（非香港政治人物）及第15條（高風險情況，包括關長指明的情況）
第5條及第6條
第20條及第21條
第12條及第13條
tc.explain: 附表2第10條就屬非香港政治人物的客戶／實益擁有人施加強制性的更嚴格盡職審查措施（高級管理層批准、財富及資金來源、更嚴格監察）；第15條規定在按性質屬高風險或關長指明的情況採取特別／更嚴格措施。第5條為持續監察；第12／13條為電傳轉帳及匯款；第20／21條為紀錄。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第12(2)條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第10.4段

en.q: To which of the following does the wire-transfer information regime in section 12 of Schedule 2 NOT apply?
options: A wire transfer between an MSO and a financial institution where each acts on its own behalf, and card-based transactions (credit/debit/prepaid) not used for person-to-person transfers
Any wire transfer below $50,000
Wire transfers to family members
Wire transfers denominated in foreign currencies
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.12(2) (¶10.4): the s.12 requirements do not apply to (a) transfers between an MSO and an FI each acting on its own behalf; (b) transfers between an MSO and a foreign institution each acting on its own behalf; or (c) card-based transactions where the card is not used for person-to-person transfers and the card number accompanies the transfer. There is no exemption based on amount, currency or family relationship.

tc.q: 附表2第12條的電傳轉帳資料規定不適用於下列哪項？
options: 金錢服務經營者與金融機構之間、各自代表本身行事的電傳轉帳；以及並非用作人對人轉帳的信用咭／扣帳咭／預付咭交易
任何低於50,000元的電傳轉帳
匯給家庭成員的電傳轉帳
以外幣結算的電傳轉帳
tc.explain: 附表2第12(2)條（第10.4段）：第12條規定不適用於：(a)金錢服務經營者與金融機構之間、各自只代表本身行事的電傳轉帳；(b)與外地機構之間、各自只代表本身行事的電傳轉帳；及(c)以咭進行、並非用作人對人轉帳且咭號碼附隨轉帳的交易。並無按金額、貨幣或親屬關係而設的豁免。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13條；《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》第11.3及11.6段

en.q: Before carrying out a remittance transaction (other than a wire transfer) of $8,000 or above, section 13 of Schedule 2 requires the MSO to:
options: Identify the originator, verify the originator's identity by reference to their identification document, and record prescribed particulars including the originator's name, ID document number, address, currency and amount, and the recipient's details
Obtain the recipient's consent in writing
Report the transaction to the JFIU in advance
Hold the funds for 24 hours before remitting
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.13: before a remittance transaction of $8,000 or above (other than a wire transfer), the MSO must identify and verify the originator by reference to their identification document and record the prescribed particulars — originator's name, ID document number (and place of issue for travel documents), address, currency and amount, date/time of instruction, recipient's name and address and delivery method (¶11.6).

tc.q: 在進行8,000元或以上的匯款交易（電傳轉帳除外）前，附表2第13條規定金錢服務經營者須：
options: 識別匯款人、按其身分證明文件核實其身分，並記錄訂明資料，包括匯款人姓名、身分證明文件號碼、地址、貨幣及金額，以及收款人的資料
取得收款人的書面同意
預先向聯合財富情報組申報該交易
先扣起款項24小時才匯出
tc.explain: 附表2第13條：進行8,000元或以上的匯款交易（電傳轉帳除外）前，須識別匯款人並按其身分證明文件核實其身分，並記錄訂明資料——匯款人姓名、身分證明文件號碼（旅行證件則連同簽發地點）、地址、所涉貨幣及金額、收到指示的日期及時間、收款人姓名及地址與交付方式（第11.6段）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第13A條

en.q: Section 13A of Schedule 2 imposes special requirements on which type of transaction?
options: Virtual asset transfers — transfers of virtual assets carried out by an ordering institution on behalf of an originator to make them available to a recipient at a beneficiary institution
Cheque deposits
Physical gold shipments
Foreign currency cash exchanges
en.explain: s.13A (added by the 2022 amendments) defines a virtual asset transfer — mirroring the wire-transfer structure of ordering, intermediary and beneficiary institutions — and imposes originator/recipient information requirements before carrying out VA transfers; the $8,000 CDD threshold applies to occasional VA transfers (s.3(1)).

tc.q: 附表2第13A條就哪類交易施加特別規定？
options: 虛擬資產轉移——由轉移機構代表匯款人轉移虛擬資產，使收款人可在收款機構取得該資產
支票存款
實金付運
外幣現鈔兌換
tc.explain: 第13A條（2022年修訂加入）界定虛擬資產轉移——結構與電傳轉帳的匯款、中介及收款機構相對應——並就進行虛擬資產轉移前的匯款人／收款人資料施加規定；非經常虛擬資產轉移適用8,000元的盡職審查門檻（第3(1)條）。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第20及21條（第3部）

en.q: Under Part 3 of Schedule 2, in what form may required records be kept?
options: As original documents, or copies kept on microfilm or in a computer database; data and information records on microfilm or in a computer database
Original paper documents only — electronic copies are not permitted
Any form, provided records are destroyed within one year
Verbal records maintained by the compliance officer
en.explain: Sch. 2 s.21: where a record consists of a document, either the original or a copy on microfilm or in a computer database must be kept; records of data or information are kept on microfilm or in a computer database. s.20 sets the retention periods (at least 5 years) and allows the CCE to require longer retention by written notice.

tc.q: 根據附表2第3部，規定備存的紀錄可以何種形式保存？
options: 文件正本，或以縮微膠卷或電腦數據庫形式保存的副本；數據或資料紀錄則以縮微膠卷或電腦數據庫保存
只可保存文件正本——不准電子副本
任何形式均可，惟紀錄須於一年內銷毀
由合規主任以口頭方式記存
tc.explain: 附表2第21條：如紀錄屬文件，須保存正本，或以縮微膠卷或電腦數據庫保存副本；如紀錄屬數據或資料，須以縮微膠卷或電腦數據庫保存。第20條訂明保存期（最少5年），關長並可以書面通知要求更長的保存期。

source.tc: 《打擊洗錢條例》附表2第22及23條

en.q: Which of the following correctly pairs sections 22 and 23 of Schedule 2 with their subject matter?
options: s.22 — ensuring overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings have procedures for similar CDD/record-keeping compliance; s.23 — the duty to maintain safeguards and mitigate ML/TF risks
s.22 — licence fees; s.23 — staff training requirements
s.22 — wire transfers; s.23 — remittance transactions
s.22 — the register of licensees; s.23 — the Review Tribunal
en.explain: s.22 requires a Hong Kong-incorporated institution to ensure its overseas branches and subsidiary undertakings (carrying on similar business) have procedures for compliance with CDD and record-keeping requirements similar to Parts 2 and 3, to the extent local law permits — with the CCE informed where local law prevents it. s.23 requires all reasonable measures to ensure proper safeguards exist and to mitigate ML/TF risks.

tc.q: 下列哪項正確配對附表2第22條及第23條的主題？
options: 第22條——確保外地分行及附屬企業設有程序，遵守類似的盡職審查／備存紀錄規定；第23條——維持保障措施及減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險的責任
第22條——牌照費用；第23條——職員培訓規定
第22條——電傳轉帳；第23條——匯款交易
第22條——持牌人登記冊；第23條——覆核審裁處
tc.explain: 第22條規定在香港成立為法團的機構，須確保其經營類似業務的外地分行及附屬企業設有程序，在當地法律准許的範圍內遵守與附表2第2及3部相類似的盡職審查及備存紀錄規定——如當地法律不准許，須通知關長。第23條規定須採取一切合理措施，確保設有合適的保障措施及減低洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第1.1段

en.q: Since when has the Customs and Excise Department been the authority regulating money service operators, and under which ordinance?
options: Since 1 April 2012, under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance (Cap. 615)
Since 1997, under the Banking Ordinance
Since 2018, under the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance
Since 2022, under the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance
en.explain: Licensing Guide §1.1: the C&ED has been the authority for regulating MSOs with effect from 1 April 2012, with the relevant powers provided under the AMLO (Cap. 615).

tc.q: 香港海關自何時起成為規管金錢服務經營者的當局？依據哪條條例？
options: 自2012年4月1日起，依據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》（第615章）
自1997年起，依據《銀行業條例》
自2018年起，依據《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》
自2022年起，依據《支付系統及儲值支付工具條例》
tc.explain: 《牌照指引》第1.1段：海關自2012年4月1日起成為規管金錢服務經營者的當局，相關權力由《打擊洗錢條例》（第615章）賦予。

en.q: What is the normal validity period of an MSO licence, and when does a licence otherwise cease to be valid?
options: Normally 2 years; it also ceases on the death of an individual licensee, dissolution of a partnership, or commencement of winding up of a corporation
Normally 1 year, renewable monthly
Normally 5 years with no other cessation events
Indefinitely, until surrendered
en.explain: §2.10: a licence is normally valid for 2 years and must be renewed before expiry to continue operating. It otherwise ceases to be valid on the death of an individual licensee, the dissolution of a partnership, or the commencement of winding up of a corporate licensee.

tc.q: 金錢服務經營者牌照一般的有效期是多久？牌照在其他哪些情況下失效？
options: 一般為2年；如屬個人持牌人身故、合夥解散，或法團開始清盤，牌照亦告失效
一般為1年，按月續期
一般為5年，並無其他失效情況
無限期，直至交回為止
tc.explain: 第2.10段：牌照一般有效期為2年，如欲繼續經營須在期滿前申請續期。另外，個人持牌人身故、合夥解散或法團持牌人開始清盤時，牌照即失效。

en.q: If the CCE refuses an application for the grant of an MSO licence, what happens to the application fee and fit-and-proper test fee already paid?
options: No refund is made, irrespective of whether the application is approved or refused
Both fees are refunded in full
Half of each fee is refunded
The fees are credited towards a future application
en.explain: §2.8: no refund of the application fee is made irrespective of whether the application is approved or refused. §4.14: the fit-and-proper person test fee is likewise non-refundable.

tc.q: 如關長拒絕批出金錢服務經營者牌照，已繳付的申請費及適當人選審查費會如何處理？
options: 不論申請獲批准與否，費用概不退還
兩項費用全數退還
各退還一半
費用可轉作日後申請之用
tc.explain: 第2.8段：不論申請其後獲批准或被拒絕，已收取的申請費概不退還。第4.14段：適當人選審查費同樣不獲退還。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第2.3段

en.q: According to the Licensing Guide, which of the following does NOT count as a licensable money changing service?
options: A retail shop accepting foreign currencies in sales transactions, incidental to its main business
A dedicated street-level currency exchange shop
An office operating currency exchange for walk-in customers as its business
A company whose business is buying and selling foreign banknotes to the public
en.explain: §2.3: a money changing service is currency exchange operated in Hong Kong as a business, but excludes a service incidental to the main business (e.g. a retail business accepting foreign currencies in transactions) and a hotel service run primarily for guests' convenience consisting solely of buying foreign currency for HK currency.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，下列哪項不屬須領牌的貨幣兌換服務？
options: 零售商店在交易中附帶接受外幣，屬其主要業務的附帶服務
專營的臨街貨幣找換店
以兌換貨幣為業務、接待街客的辦事處
以向公眾買賣外幣鈔票為業務的公司
tc.explain: 第2.3段：貨幣兌換服務指在香港作為業務經營的兌換貨幣服務，但不包括附帶於主要業務的服務（例如零售商在交易中接受外幣），亦不包括酒店主要為方便住客而設、只包含以港幣購買非香港貨幣交易的服務。

source.en: Licensing Guide (May 2026) §4.3; Guideline on Criteria for Determining Fitness and Propriety (Apr 2018)
source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第4.3段；《有關適當人選準則的指引》（2018年4月）

en.q: In determining whether a person is fit and proper, the CCE must have regard to all of the following EXCEPT:
options: The person's academic qualifications in finance
Convictions for ML/TF-related offences (in Hong Kong or elsewhere)
Whether the person is an undischarged bankrupt or subject to bankruptcy proceedings
Whether a corporate applicant is in liquidation or subject to a winding-up order
en.explain: §4.3 (and the F&P Guideline): the CCE must consider convictions for specified AMLO/UNATMO/DTROP/OSCO offences and overseas equivalents (including ML/TF and fraud/dishonesty offences), persistent non-compliance with the AMLO, bankruptcy (individuals), liquidation/receivership (corporations), and any other relevant matter. Academic qualifications are not a listed criterion.

tc.q: 關長在決定某人是否屬適當人選時，必須考慮下列各項，但不包括：
options: 該人的金融學歷
（在香港或其他地方）因洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集相關罪行被定罪
該人是否未獲解除破產的破產人或破產程序的對象
法團申請人是否正在清盤或屬清盤令的對象
tc.explain: 第4.3段（及《適當人選準則指引》）：關長須考慮：因《打擊洗錢條例》／《聯合國（反恐怖主義措施）條例》／《販毒條例》／《有組織及嚴重罪行條例》指明罪行（及海外同類罪行，包括洗錢及涉欺詐、貪污、不誠實的罪行）被定罪；持續不遵守條例；個人破產情況；法團清盤／接管情況；以及其他有關事宜。學歷並非所列準則。

en.q: An applicant intends to operate a money service with no particular premises (e.g. purely via mobile devices). What must it provide?
options: A local management office (LMO), a correspondence address and a local place for storage of books and records — the LMO staffed by the proprietor/partner/director/ultimate owner and/or CO, not a service provider's address
Nothing beyond an email address
A P.O. Box in Hong Kong
An overseas head-office address
en.explain: §4.5/§4.7: an applicant operating without particular premises must provide an LMO (a physical office reachable in person and by phone by C&ED, staffed by the sole proprietor, partner, director, ultimate owner and/or CO), a correspondence address and an LPS. Residential addresses or the premises of service providers (company secretaries, accountants, solicitors) are not accepted; failure to maintain the LMO can lead to suspension/revocation.

tc.q: 申請人擬在沒有特定處所的情況下經營金錢服務（例如純以流動裝置進行交易）。它必須提供甚麼？
options: 本地管理辦事處、通訊地址及本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點——本地管理辦事處的人員須為東主／合夥人／董事／最終擁有人及／或合規主任，不接受服務供應商的地址
只須提供電郵地址
一個香港郵政信箱
海外總部地址
tc.explain: 第4.5及4.7段：無特定處所經營者必須提供本地管理辦事處（海關人員可親身到達及以電話聯絡的實體辦公室，人員須為獨資經營者、合夥人、董事、最終擁有人及／或合規主任）、通訊地址及本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點。住宅地址或服務供應商（公司秘書行、會計師行、律師行）的處所不獲接納；未能維持本地管理辦事處可導致牌照被暫時吊銷及／或撤銷。

en.q: Which statement about the local place for storage of books and records (LPS) is CORRECT?
options: ALL applicants must provide an LPS in Hong Kong — a physical place under the licensee's control keeping the full set of money service books and records, accessible to C&ED officers
Only applicants with more than one shop need an LPS
Records may simply be kept at the licensee's accounting firm
Cloud storage overseas replaces the need for an LPS
en.explain: §4.10–4.11: all applicants are required to have an LPS in Hong Kong — a physical place keeping the full set of books and records of money service transactions, under the licensee's control to facilitate C&ED access. Residential premises or service providers' addresses (company secretarial, accounting or solicitor firms) are not accepted. Failing to maintain the LPS can lead to suspension/revocation.

tc.q: 關於本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點，下列哪項正確？
options: 所有申請人均須在香港提供本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點——由持牌人控制、存放整套金錢服務交易簿冊及紀錄的實體地點，供海關人員查閱
只有經營多於一間店舖的申請人才需要
紀錄存放於持牌人的會計師行即可
以海外雲端儲存取代即可
tc.explain: 第4.10至4.11段：所有申請人均須提供位於香港的本地儲存帳目及紀錄地點——存放整套金錢服務交易簿冊及紀錄的實體地點，且須由持牌人控制，方便海關人員查閱。住宅處所或服務供應商（公司秘書行、會計師行、律師行）的地址不獲接納。未能維持該地點可導致牌照被暫時吊銷及／或撤銷。

en.q: Which of the following premises would be considered SUITABLE for registration as MSO business premises?
options: Premises in a mixed commercial and residential building, where the applicant has secured the written consent of every occupant for C&ED authorized persons to enter for inspection
Premises in a wholly residential building
Premises already used by another MSO for operating its money service
Premises whose signboard shows a business name different from the Business Registration Certificate
en.explain: §4.6: premises must be accessible to C&ED officers; in a mixed commercial/residential building the written consent of every occupant is needed. NOT suitable: premises in wholly residential buildings, premises used or declared by another MSO, premises accessible only through another party's area, and premises whose signboard name differs from the registered business name.

tc.q: 下列哪類處所會被視為適合登記為金錢服務經營者的營業處所？
options: 位於商住混合大廈的處所，而申請人已取得每名佔用人的書面同意，讓海關獲授權人員進入查察
位於純住宅大廈的處所
已被另一金錢服務經營者用作經營金錢服務的處所
招牌顯示的商號名稱與商業登記證不符的處所
tc.explain: 第4.6段：處所須讓海關人員可進入執行職務；位於商住混合大廈的處所，須取得每名佔用人的書面同意。不適合的處所包括：位於純住宅大廈、已被其他經營者使用或申報、須經他人範圍才能進入，以及招牌名稱與商業登記證登記名稱不符的處所。

en.q: Which statement about the appointment of the CO and MLRO as a licensing requirement is CORRECT?
options: Unless the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner personally takes the role, the CO and MLRO must be the applicant's employee within the meaning of the Employment Ordinance
The CO and MLRO may be freelance consultants paid per assignment
The roles may be left vacant for up to a year
The CO must be a lawyer and the MLRO an accountant
en.explain: §4.15(a): an applicant must appoint a competent CO and MLRO; except where the sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner is also the CO/MLRO, they must be the applicant's employee under the Employment Ordinance (Cap. 57). Failing to appoint or maintain a competent CO/MLRO is a ground for refusing, suspending or revoking a licence (§5.10(g), §7.1(i)).

tc.q: 關於委任合規主任及洗錢報告主任作為發牌規定，下列哪項正確？
options: 除非由獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人親自兼任，否則合規主任及洗錢報告主任必須是申請人按《僱傭條例》定義的僱員
可委任按項目收費的自由顧問擔任
有關職位可懸空長達一年
合規主任須為律師，洗錢報告主任須為會計師
tc.explain: 第4.15(a)段：申請人須委任稱職的合規主任及洗錢報告主任；除由獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人兼任外，兩者必須是申請人按《僱傭條例》（第57章）定義的僱員。未能委任或維持稱職的合規主任／洗錢報告主任，是拒絕批出、暫時吊銷或撤銷牌照的理由（第5.10(g)及7.1(i)段）。

en.q: Which statement about the Competence Assessment as a licensing requirement is CORRECT?
options: The sole proprietor, any one of the partners or directors must pass the Assessment; its result is one of the factors the CCE considers in determining fitness and properness
Every employee of the applicant must pass the Assessment
Passing the Assessment guarantees the grant of a licence
The Assessment is voluntary and has no bearing on the licence
en.explain: §4.15(b): the sole proprietor, any one of the partners and directors must pass the Competence Assessment, which ensures senior management understands ML/TF risks and can implement effective AML/CFT systems. §5.4: the result is one of the factors relevant to the fit-and-proper determination — passing does not by itself qualify the applicant for a licence.

tc.q: 關於能力評核作為發牌規定，下列哪項正確？
options: 獨資經營者、任何一名合夥人或董事必須在能力評核取得合格成績；評核結果是關長釐定適當人選時考慮的因素之一
申請人的每名僱員均須通過評核
通過評核保證獲批牌照
評核屬自願性質，與牌照無關
tc.explain: 第4.15(b)段：獨資經營者、任何一名合夥人及董事必須在海關舉行的能力評核取得合格成績，以確保高級管理層清楚了解洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險並有能力推行有效的打擊洗錢制度。第5.4段：評核結果是關長釐定申請人是否適當人選的考慮因素之一——合格本身不代表必獲批牌照。

en.q: Under the Licensing Guide, which of the following is an express example of a situation where the CCE may REFUSE to grant a licence?
options: None of the applicant's senior management (sole proprietor, partner or director) attends or passes the designated Competence Assessment
The applicant's projected profits are too low
The applicant has fewer than three staff
The applicant's office is smaller than 200 square feet
en.explain: §5.10 lists refusal examples: failing the fit-and-proper test, unsuitable premises, missing occupant consents, no LPS/LMO information, no compliant Business Plan/AML Policy, no competent CO/MLRO, incomplete applications, none of the senior management attending (i) or passing (j) the Assessment, and exempted persons. Profitability, headcount and office size are not listed grounds.

tc.q: 根據《牌照指引》，下列哪項是關長可拒絕批出牌照的明文例子？
options: 申請人的高級管理層（獨資經營者、合夥人或董事）無人出席或無人通過指定的能力評核
申請人的預計利潤太低
申請人僱員少於三人
申請人的辦公室面積小於200平方呎
tc.explain: 第5.10段列出可拒絕批出牌照的例子：未能通過適當人選審查、處所不適合、未取得佔用人同意書、未提供儲存紀錄地點／本地管理辦事處資料、未按指引提交業務計劃及打擊洗錢政策、未委任稱職的合規主任或洗錢報告主任、申請不完整、高級管理層無人出席（第(i)項）或無人通過（第(j)項）評核，以及屬獲豁免人士。利潤、人手及辦公室面積並非所列理由。

en.q: Which statement about the licence renewal process is CORRECT?
options: C&ED sends a reminder with the Assessment invitation 90 days before expiry; the licensee must nominate eligible person(s) within 7 days of receiving the invitation, and they attend the Assessment within 30 days — but applying for renewal 45 days before expiry remains the licensee's legal responsibility
The reminder letter relieves the licensee of the 45-day renewal deadline
Renewal happens automatically unless the CCE objects
The Assessment is waived on renewal
en.explain: §6.2: a reminder with the Assessment invitation is sent 90 days before expiry; nomination must be made within 7 days of receipt and attendance within 30 days; it remains the licensee's legal responsibility to apply 45 days before expiry. §6.4: an invalid renewal application means the licence lapses automatically on expiry — continuing to operate would be unlicensed operation, an offence.

tc.q: 關於牌照續期程序，下列哪項正確？
options: 海關會在期滿前90日發出提示信連同能力評核邀請信；持牌人須在接獲邀請信後7日內提名合資格人士，獲提名者須在30日內應考——但在期滿前45日申請續期仍是持牌人的法律責任
提示信免除持牌人45日限期的責任
除非關長反對，牌照會自動續期
續期時豁免能力評核
tc.explain: 第6.2段：海關會在牌照期滿前90日向持牌人發出提示信連同評核邀請信；持牌人須在接獲邀請信後7日內提名合資格人士，獲提名者須在接獲邀請信後30日內應考；在期滿前45日申請續期仍是持牌人的法律責任。第6.4段：無效的續期申請會令牌照在有效期屆滿時自動失效——繼續經營即屬無牌經營，屬刑事罪行。

en.q: Which of the following is an express example in the Licensing Guide of a ground on which the CCE may revoke or suspend a licence?
options: The licensee has never actually provided a money service, so holding the licence fails to fulfil its purpose
The licensee changed its opening hours
The licensee declined to sponsor a community event
The licensee switched to a cheaper office in the same building
en.explain: §7.1 examples include: loss of fit-and-proper status; occupants revoking consent; failure to maintain the LPS or LMO; failure to submit periodic returns on time; holding the licence without providing a money service; non-compliance with AMLO requirements; and failure to appoint or maintain a competent CO or MLRO. The licensee gets an opportunity to be heard (§7.2) and may appeal to the Review Tribunal within 21 days (§7.3).

tc.q: 下列哪項是《牌照指引》明文所載、關長可撤銷或暫時吊銷牌照的理由例子？
options: 持牌人從未實際提供金錢服務，持有牌照未能符合發牌目的
持牌人更改營業時間
持牌人拒絕贊助社區活動
持牌人搬往同一大廈較便宜的辦公室
tc.explain: 第7.1段的例子包括：不再屬適當人選；佔用人撤回同意書；未能維持儲存紀錄地點或本地管理辦事處；未能按時遞交定期申報表；持有牌照而未能符合發牌目的（例如從未提供金錢服務）；不遵守條例規定；及未能委任或維持稱職的合規主任或洗錢報告主任。持牌人有陳詞機會（第7.2段），並可在21日內向覆核審裁處上訴（第7.3段）。

en.q: Which of the following correctly matches the C&ED forms with their purposes?
options: Form 4 — approval of a proposed director/ultimate owner/partner; Form 5 — adding business premises; Form 6 — notification of changes in particulars; Form 7 — notification of cessation of business
Form 4 — cessation; Form 5 — change of particulars; Form 6 — new premises; Form 7 — new directors
Form 4 — licence application; Form 5 — renewal; Form 6 — periodic return; Form 7 — appeal
Form 4 — periodic return; Form 5 — STR; Form 6 — appeal; Form 7 — renewal
en.explain: Per the Licensing Guide: Form 1 is the licence application, Form 2 renewal, Forms 3A/3B fit-and-proper declarations, Form 4 the application for prior approval of a proposed director/ultimate owner/partner (§8.1–8.3), Form 5 adding premises (§8.4), Form 6 notification of changes in particulars (§9.1), and Form 7 notification of cessation of business (§10.2).

tc.q: 下列哪項正確配對海關表格及其用途？
options: 表格4——擬任董事／最終擁有人／合夥人的事先批准申請；表格5——增加營業處所；表格6——資料變更通知；表格7——停業通知
表格4——停業；表格5——資料變更；表格6——新處所；表格7——新董事
表格4——牌照申請；表格5——續期；表格6——定期申報表；表格7——上訴
表格4——定期申報表；表格5——可疑交易報告；表格6——上訴；表格7——續期
tc.explain: 根據《牌照指引》：表格1為牌照申請；表格2為續期；表格3A／3B為適當人選聲明；表格4為擬任董事／最終擁有人／合夥人的事先批准申請（第8.1至8.3段）；表格5為增加營業處所（第8.4段）；表格6為資料變更通知（第9.1段）；表格7為停業通知（第10.2段）。

source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第8.5段；《打擊洗錢條例》第35(7)條

en.q: A person becomes a director of a licensed MSO corporation without the CCE's prior written approval. What is the criminal penalty on conviction?
options: A fine of HK$50,000 and imprisonment for 6 months
A fine of HK$1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years
A fine of HK$10,000,000
Community service only
en.explain: §8.5: contravening s.35(1) without reasonable excuse is an offence with a fine of HK$50,000 and 6 months' imprisonment on conviction; the same penalty applies for contraventions of ss.36(1), 37(1), 38(1) and 39(1). The CCE may additionally take disciplinary action under s.43(1)(c) — and suspend or revoke the licence.

tc.q: 某人未經關長事先書面批准便成為持牌金錢服務經營者（法團）的董事。一經定罪，刑罰為何？
options: 罰款50,000元及監禁6個月
罰款100萬元及監禁2年
罰款1,000萬元
只須社會服務令
tc.explain: 第8.5段：無合理辯解而違反第35(1)條即屬犯罪，一經定罪可處罰款50,000元及監禁6個月；違反第36(1)、37(1)、38(1)及39(1)條的刑罰相同。關長另可根據第43(1)(c)條採取紀律行動，並可暫時吊銷或撤銷牌照。

en.q: How often, and by when, must a licensee lodge periodic returns with the CCE?
options: Within 2 weeks beginning from each half year, in the form and manner specified by the CCE, unless otherwise specified by written notice
Once a year, within 3 months of the financial year end
Monthly, by the 5th of the following month
Only when requested by the CCE
en.explain: §11.2: a licensee must lodge a periodic return within 2 weeks beginning from each half year (unless the CCE specifies otherwise by notice in writing), in the specified form and manner. Failure to submit on time may result in suspension and/or revocation of the licence — it is also an express revocation example in §7.1(f).

tc.q: 持牌人須多久及在何時前向關長遞交定期申報表？
options: 除關長另以書面通知指明外，須在每半年開始起計2星期內，按關長指明的格式及方式遞交
每年一次，於財政年度結束後3個月內
每月一次，於翌月5日前
只在關長要求時
tc.explain: 第11.2段：持牌人須在每半年開始起計2星期內（除非關長以書面通知另行指明），按指明格式及方式遞交定期申報表。未能按時遞交可導致牌照被暫時吊銷及／或撤銷——這亦是第7.1(f)段明文所載的撤銷理由例子。

source.en: Licensing Guide (May 2026) §11.1(j); Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan (12/2019), item 8
source.tc: 《牌照指引》（2026年5月）第11.1(j)段；《遞交業務計劃的指引》（12-2019版）第8項

en.q: Which statement about bank accounts used for operating the money service business is CORRECT?
options: The account must be in the name of the licensee's company, or its sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner — third-party bank accounts are not allowed
Any account may be used, including accounts of friends or business associates
Bank accounts are prohibited for MSOs
Only overseas bank accounts may be used
en.explain: §11.1(j): where bank accounts are used for the money service business, they must be in the name of the licensee's company, sole proprietor, partner, director or ultimate owner. The Business Plan guidelines likewise require account details and state that no third-party bank account is allowed; an applicant operating without a bank account must explain how the business operates.

tc.q: 關於用於經營金錢服務業務的銀行戶口，下列哪項正確？
options: 戶口必須以持牌人公司、獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人的名義開立——不容許使用第三者銀行戶口
任何戶口均可使用，包括朋友或生意夥伴的戶口
金錢服務經營者禁止使用銀行戶口
只可使用海外銀行戶口
tc.explain: 第11.1(j)段：如以銀行戶口經營金錢服務業務，戶口必須以持牌人公司、獨資經營者、合夥人、董事或最終擁有人的名義開立。《遞交業務計劃的指引》同樣要求提供戶口資料，並訂明不容許第三者銀行戶口；如不使用銀行戶口經營，申請人須詳述業務如何運作。

source.en: Circular MSSB/MIS_02/2026 (13 Mar 2026); Circular MSSB/MIS_03/2026 (15 May 2026)

en.q: According to the 2026 circulars on fee revision, which statement is CORRECT?
options: Twelve licensing fees were revised with effect from 15 May 2026 — e.g. the licence grant application fee rose from $3,310 to $3,810 and the renewal fee from $790 to $910 — in line with the user-pays principle
All licensing fees were abolished from 15 May 2026
Fees were reduced by half to support the industry
Only the fit-and-proper test fee changed, from $945 to $860
en.explain: The 13 March 2026 circular announced the gazettal of the Amendment of Schedule 3 Notice 2026 revising 12 fees effective 15 May 2026: grant $3,310→$3,810; additional premises $2,220→$2,440; F&P test $860→$945; renewal $790→$910 (additional premises $355→$410); approvals $860→$945 per person. The 15 May 2026 circular confirmed the revised Licensing Guide took immediate effect.

tc.q: 根據2026年有關費用調整的通函，下列哪項正確？
options: 發牌制度下12項費用自2026年5月15日起調整——例如牌照批給申請費由3,310元調升至3,810元、續期費由790元調升至910元——以符合「用者自付」原則
所有牌照費用自2026年5月15日起取消
費用減半以支援業界
只有適當人選審查費有變，由945元調整至860元
tc.explain: 2026年3月13日的通函公布政府刊憲修訂附表3，12項費用於2026年5月15日起生效：批給申請3,310→3,810元；每個額外營業處所2,220→2,440元；適當人選審查860→945元；續期790→910元（額外處所355→410元）；董事／最終擁有人／合夥人批准申請每人860→945元。2026年5月15日的通函確認經修訂的《牌照指引》即時生效。

source.en: Circular MSSB/MIS_01/2026 — Trade-based Money Laundering (20 Jan 2026)
source.tc: 通函MSSB/MIS_01/2026——打擊以貿易進行洗錢活動指引（2026年1月20日）

en.q: What does the January 2026 C&ED circular on trade-based money laundering (TBML) warn MSOs about?
